title: ACL Change Role 0.2 — payload
description: Move a subject's AclEntry 0.2 from one role to another, with a compare-and-swap on the current role. Only the role changes; the entry's other members are carried over and re-evaluated against the new role's ceilings. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

subject.description: VID of the party whose role is changing.

fromRole.description: The subject's current role. The maintainer refuses the change with `stateMismatch` if it differs from the stored role.

toRole.description: The role to move the subject to.

Response.title: ACL Change Role 0.2 — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/change-role/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/change-role/0.2#response.

entry.description: The AclEntry the maintainer now holds for the subject. `entry.role` MUST equal the request's `toRole`.
